name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Tauri 2.x desktop shell: spawns `dsh --profile web` as a Node host subprocess and embeds the built web frontend in a system WebView (Windows/macOS/Linux). The Tauri process adds native menu, tray, and IPC-only system capabilities on top of the unchanged Cordis plugin tree.

scripts.dev: pnpm run sync:web && cargo tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm run before:build && pnpm run sync:web && cargo tauri build
scripts.build:debug: pnpm run before:build && pnpm run sync:web && cargo tauri build --debug
